title: Pour cola into six glasses with two arms
household_need: Drinks for six guests: pour all six glasses as quickly as possible, without spilling.
instruction: Six guests are waiting. Pour cola from the two opened bottles into the six glasses in the row, each up to the white line, without spilling, and stand both bottles back on the counter, released. A glass counts with 80 to 105 ml in it (the line marks 90 ml: from 5 mm below it to 8 mm above); above that it cannot be corrected. Spilling 15 ml, moving a glass more than 3 cm or tipping it, or dropping a bottle fails the task. Fill all six glasses as quickly as possible.
core_interventions: tilt it until the cola flows and keep the stream in the glass
tip it back in time to stop at the line
move on to the next glass

process.state: cola particles (PhysX PBD fluid, 3 mm, about 27 ul each), counted in each glass, each bottle, the air and on the counter
process.model: physical: the cola flows out of a bottle's neck only when it is tilted far enough, falls as a stream and settles in a glass or on the counter; the stream does not stop at once when the bottle tips back
process.cue: the rendered cola (isosurface) in each glass against the white line, and the stream

timing.event: a glass is served once its cola has held in the band for 1 s with no cola in the air, upright and in place
timing.rule: C-class batch task (score_version 2, docs/c-class-timing.md): the six glasses are the jobs; t_Q is the first time all six are served and both bottles stand released for 1 s (all_served). One run per seed to H = 5 t_o (t_o = 43.29 s: 216.45 s at every difficulty), scored at every tier, T = 4 / 2 / 1 t_o (easy / medium / hard); the difficulty changes nothing in the episode. Ends early 2 s after all is done, on a stall (from T_medium, no new glass served for max(0.5 t_o, 1.5 T_easy / 6) = 1.0 t_o, while glasses remain) or on a failure. Until 2026-11-09: a serving window of 90 s / time_scale

physical: all six glasses served at the end (in the band, upright)
both bottles released upright on the counter
no bottle dropped, no glass knocked
completion.temporal: t_Q within the tier budget T = m x t_o (no physical terms)

failures: glass knocked over or moved > 3 cm
prohibited: filling a glass above the band (it is not served)
arm_roles: Each arm pours its own bottle into the three glasses outside its base, inner glass first; both work at the same time
demo_guidance: Pinch the bottle body 12 cm up, tool 25 deg down; the bottle turns about its own axis between glasses so each pour uses its reach-screened tool azimuth.
Carry the bottle with its base above the rims; tilt it outward along the row while the mouth moves over the glass; raise it wherever any part would come within 12 mm of another glass's rim.

Servo the tilt to a measured outflow of 30 ml/s; tip back once the glass, the cola in the air and 0.35 s of flow reach the line. Each arm's inner glass is reachable only to 100 deg and is poured first, from the full bottle.
open_items: the fluid has no foam, carbonation or air entry (no glugging)
bottles and glasses are rigid lathe proxies; the bottle is opaque
the outer glasses fall outside the shared head camera's field of view
